newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends lower on falls abroad.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends lower on falls abroad.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended lower in another slow trading day, with falls in overseas and sluggish demand prompting selling, traders said.
"Falls in Tokyo had dragged down prices. The slow demand from overseas particulary from Europe also hit sentiment," a dealer said, adding that inquiries from Iran have not translated into deals.

There was some Chinese interest and local dealers had offered them SMR 20, RSS3 and RSS1 for nearby shipments. No deals were transacted as buyers felt that prices could drift lower amid uncertainty in the Tokyo market.
